source: https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com eth_getTransactionReceipt; tx list = robinhoodtrenches.com/api/tape rows captured 2026-09-06T17:52:25.120Z
note: Per tx only blockNumber, status and logs are kept; per log only address, topics, data, logIndex (transactionHash/blockHash/blockNumber/transactionIndex are redundant with the key).
trimRule: Non-Multicall3 txs keep every ERC-20 Transfer (0xddf252ad…), UserOperationEvent (0x49628fd1…) and WETH Deposit/Withdrawal (0xe1fffcc4…/0x7fcf532c…) log verbatim in logIndex order; Swap/Approval/other events dropped. Multicall3 bundles (tx.to 0xca11bde0…, tx.from 0xe1f7f5a4…) additionally keep only the Transfers whose topics[1] or topics[2] is a robinhoodtrenches trader wallet; their dropped distribution is summarised in bundleSummary (distinct tokens/recipients/senders, per-token transfer counts). logsTotal/logsKept/topic0Histogram record what was dropped.
